note: 十段人工双语成本全员会草稿，含管理层决策与员工追问。仅引用p001-p350及本文件前段；回访候选不计实绩。音色待确认，音频口音时长待核验，无预填时间轴。

series.title: 基础设施成本全员会：预算决策与员工问答
series.premise: 季度全员会公布云预算压力及降本方向。账单随客户增长、重复导出和测试资源遗留而增加；员工关注裁员、可靠性和团队考核。
series.outcome: 决定先清理经依赖确认的浪费、进行有安全门槛的规格试点，不削减备份和故障余量，不立即签长期承诺。明确本次决策不含裁员，目标是单位有效工作成本改善；四周后公开结果和未决问题。

Priya.role: Head of infrastructure and all-hands host

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 不分情况的一刀切削减

recycling.note: 以下仅为未来回访候选，不代表已完成目标次数。

dialogues.title: 先听今天真正决定什么
dialogues.premise: 季度全员会开场，管理层解释云成本讨论的范围。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分预算决定、降本方向和未宣布事项。

lines.en: Today's topic is our cloud budget envelope. We're deciding priorities, not shutting services down.
lines.zh: 今天讨论云预算边界。我们决定优先级，不是关闭服务。

lines.en: Well, our quarterly limit is three hundred thousand. Current projections put us above that limit.
lines.zh: 嗯，季度上限是三十万。目前预测会超过上限。

lines.en: Customer demand grew faster than we expected. Maybe part of that spending is useful growth.
lines.zh: 客户需求增长快于预期。部分开销可能是有价值的增长。

lines.en: Are we discussing cloud charges or payroll? People need to know the scope clearly.
lines.zh: 讨论云费用还是薪酬？大家需要明确范围。

lines.en: Just to confirm, cloud charges only today, right? This decision contains no layoffs or hiring freeze.
lines.zh: 确认一下，今天只谈云费用，对吧？本次决策不含裁员或冻结招聘。

lines.en: Okay, teams have limited bandwidth this quarter. What's the ETA for the priority list?
lines.zh: 好，团队本季度精力有限。优先级清单预计何时给？

lines.en: Right, we'll share the approved priorities today. Specific savings estimates follow after the pilots finish.
lines.zh: 对，今天分享批准的优先级。试点完成后再给具体节省估算。

lines.en: A blanket percentage per team? Let's park that. Different services have different customer demand patterns.
lines.zh: 每团队统一百分比？先不这样做。不同服务客户需求不同。

lines.en: Good, but explain the guardrails too. A target shouldn't silently override service reliability.
lines.zh: 好，但也说明保障线。目标不能悄悄凌驾于可靠性。

lines.en: Just to recap, priorities and guardrails today. No promised savings before we have evidence.
lines.zh: 小结一下，今天确定优先级和保障线。有证据前不承诺节省。

dialogues.title: 预测与已结算数字分开听
dialogues.premise: 预算范围已明确，财务介绍费用类别与结算状态。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出当前预测不是已结算费用。

lines.en: Okay, the cost breakdown shows compute leading. Storage and transfers make up the remaining share.
lines.zh: 好，成本拆分显示计算占最大份额。其余是存储和传输。

lines.en: Our budget envelope covers all three categories. It doesn't mean every category needs equal reductions.
lines.zh: 预算边界覆盖三类。不是每类都要同幅削减。

lines.en: Are these actual charges or future projections? Mixing them would make this chart misleading.
lines.zh: 这些是实际费用还是未来预测？混在一起会误导。

lines.en: Let me play that back before interpreting. The solid bars show already reported usage.
lines.zh: 解释前我复述一下。实心柱显示已上报用量。

lines.en: Just to confirm, outlined bars are forecasts, right? That distinction matters when teams plan their work.
lines.zh: 确认一下，空心柱是预测，对吧？团队规划时这个区别重要。

lines.en: Yes, recent usage can still arrive late. Final settlement also includes credits and tax adjustments.
lines.zh: 对，最近用量仍可能延迟到达。最终结算还含抵扣和税费调整。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis points to repeated transfers. Maybe some compute growth also reflects abandoned tests.
lines.zh: 当前假设指向重复传输。部分计算增长也可能来自遗留测试。

lines.en: Well, can we rule that out for backups? Some apparently idle storage is essential recovery evidence.
lines.zh: 嗯，能排除备份吗？看似闲置的存储可能是必要恢复证据。

lines.en: We haven't labelled backups as waste here. Resource owners still need to confirm business dependencies.
lines.zh: 这里没把备份标为浪费。资源负责人仍需确认业务依赖。

lines.en: Okay, I'll share those distinctions with teams. Forecasts guide planning, not immediate deletion decisions.
lines.zh: 好，我向团队分享区别。预测指导规划，不直接指导删除。

dialogues.title: 总费用增长不一定代表效率下降
dialogues.premise: 成本分类已公布，产品侧说明客户需求与单位成本。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分增长带来的费用和可消除浪费。

lines.en: Well, cost per completed order stayed flat. Total orders rose by roughly twenty percent.
lines.zh: 嗯，每完成订单成本持平。总订单约增长百分之二十。

lines.en: That's useful, but define completed consistently. Failed attempts and refunds can change the denominator.
lines.zh: 有用，但完成口径要一致。失败尝试和退款会改变分母。

lines.en: The cost breakdown also isolates duplicate transfers. Those aren't explained by useful order growth.
lines.zh: 成本拆分也单列重复传输。有效订单增长解释不了它们。

lines.en: Good, don't excuse all growth as demand. Separate expected demand costs from avoidable waste.
lines.zh: 好，不要用需求解释一切增长。区分合理需求成本与可避免浪费。

lines.en: Just to confirm, comparable order definitions, right? We'll keep an eye on denominator changes.
lines.zh: 确认一下，订单定义可比，对吧？我们关注分母变化。

lines.en: Yes, only completed paid orders count here. I'll label refunded orders separately for finance.
lines.zh: 对，只算已付款完成订单。退款订单另标给财务。

lines.en: So, use consistent currency and credits throughout. Otherwise apparent improvement could come from accounting.
lines.zh: 所以，全程使用同币种和抵扣口径。否则表面改善可能只是会计变化。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis explains most transfer growth. The job audit still needs owner confirmation.
lines.zh: 当前假设解释大部分传输增长。任务审计仍需负责人确认。

lines.en: Publish that uncertainty beside the graph. Employees should see evidence, not just a persuasive headline.
lines.zh: 把不确定性写在图旁。员工应看到证据，不只看有说服力标题。

lines.en: Just to recap, growth isn't automatically waste. But growth doesn't excuse unmanaged resources either.
lines.zh: 小结一下，增长不自动等于浪费。但也不能成为无人管理资源的借口。

dialogues.title: 清重复，保恢复能力
dialogues.premise: 区分需求增长与浪费后，管理层宣布优先项目。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住优先行动和明确保护的投入。

lines.en: First, we'll protect the reliability baseline. Backups, recovery drills, and failure capacity stay funded.
lines.zh: 首先，保护可靠性基线。备份、恢复演练和故障余量继续有资金。

lines.en: Does that include the second availability zone? Redundancy can look idle during normal operation.
lines.zh: 包括第二可用区吗？正常运行时冗余可能看似闲置。

lines.en: Yes, normal idleness isn't waste by itself. We won't trade recovery capability for a chart.
lines.zh: 包括，正常空闲本身不是浪费。不会为图表牺牲恢复能力。

lines.en: So, start by removing verified duplicate work. Sizing trials come next with safety gates.
lines.zh: 所以，先移除已核实重复工作。之后是有安全门槛的规格试验。

lines.en: One action item is mapping resource dependencies. Maybe that reveals safe candidates without hurting customers.
lines.zh: 一项待办是梳理资源依赖。可能找到不影响客户的安全候选。

lines.en: Just to confirm, owner approval before stopping, right? Evidence stays under the retention policy afterward.
lines.zh: 确认一下，停用前负责人批准，对吧？之后证据按保留策略保存。

lines.en: Right, don't delete audit records for savings. Retention obligations need security and legal input.
lines.zh: 对，不能为了省钱删除审计记录。保留义务需安全和法务意见。

lines.en: Cost per completed order stays our guide. A faster cheap service can still lose data.
lines.zh: 每完成订单成本仍是参考。更快更便宜的服务仍可能丢数据。

lines.en: Long-term contracts today? Let's park that. Peak demand and exit restrictions need their own review.
lines.zh: 今天签长期合同？先放一边。峰值需求和退出限制需独立评审。

lines.en: Okay, teams can start dependency reviews now. No blanket permission to stop or delete resources.
lines.zh: 好，团队可以开始依赖评审。不是一揽子授权停用或删除资源。

dialogues.title: 承诺过程与证据，不编造节省
dialogues.premise: 优先级已发布，员工希望知道具体降本目标及计算方式。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出目标、承诺和预算决策的不同。

lines.en: We commit to publishing measured improvements monthly. The initial goal is ten percent better efficiency.
lines.zh: 承诺每月发布测得的改善。初始目标是效率提高百分之十。

lines.en: So, lower cost per completed order. It doesn't guarantee a smaller total bill.
lines.zh: 所以，是每完成订单成本更低。不保证总账单更小。

lines.en: Let me play that back as an employee. Growing teams aren't punished just for growing.
lines.zh: 我作为员工复述一下。增长团队不会仅因增长受罚。

lines.en: But how will a platform team compare? Its useful work isn't always measured in orders.
lines.zh: 但平台团队怎么比较？有效工作不总能按订单衡量。

lines.en: We'll use service-specific units for those teams. Maybe successful builds make sense for developer tooling.
lines.zh: 那些团队使用服务专属单位。开发工具可以用成功构建。

lines.en: Just to confirm, protect the reliability baseline, right? Targets don't overrule security or recovery requirements.
lines.zh: 确认一下，保护可靠性基线，对吧？目标不凌驾于安全或恢复要求。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis suggests ten percent potential. Actual pilots may show a different feasible range.
lines.zh: 当前假设提示有百分之十潜力。实际试点可能显示不同可行区间。

lines.en: Then label ten percent as a target. Teams need permission to report smaller safe savings.
lines.zh: 那就标为目标。团队需要获准报告较小但安全的节省。

lines.en: Agreed, compare quality and cost together. Otherwise teams could stop useful work to look efficient.
lines.zh: 同意，同时比较质量与成本。否则团队可能停止有效工作来显得高效。

lines.en: Okay, we'll publish each metric's definition itself. That makes comparisons open to challenge and correction.
lines.zh: 好，发布每个指标定义本身。让比较可以被质疑和修正。

dialogues.title: 共同责任不是人人背同一指标
dialogues.premise: 单位成本目标明确，管理层解释业务、平台和财务各自责任。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住跨团队责任分工而不是把降本全推给运维。

lines.en: First, shared accountability includes product demand choices. Platform teams shouldn't carry this budget alone.
lines.zh: 先明确，共同责任包括产品需求选择。平台不应独自承担预算。

lines.en: Right, finance supplies rates and reconciled charges. We also review contract restrictions before purchasing.
lines.zh: 对，财务提供费率和核对后的费用，也在采购前审阅合同限制。

lines.en: So, product will commit to naming owners. Each resource group needs a clear purpose.
lines.zh: 所以，产品承诺指定负责人。每组资源需要明确目的。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for shared services? Multiple teams may depend on the same machine.
lines.zh: 共享服务谁来接？多个团队可能依赖同一机器。

lines.en: I'll map those dependencies with service owners. We've got bandwidth for two reviews weekly.
lines.zh: 我与服务负责人梳理依赖。每周有精力做两次评审。

lines.en: Okay, the first action item is ownership. Maybe start with the biggest unexplained cost groups.
lines.zh: 好，第一项待办是归属。可以从最大未解释费用组开始。

lines.en: Good, I'll close the loop on allocations. Don't charge a shared resource entirely to one user.
lines.zh: 好，我跟进成本归属。不把共享资源全部计给一个使用者。

lines.en: Teams can challenge the allocation itself, right? We need corrections before judging any progress.
lines.zh: 团队可以质疑归属本身，对吧？评价进度前需要纠正。

lines.en: Well, reserve time for those reviews explicitly. Unfunded cost work would just become hidden overtime.
lines.zh: 嗯，明确为评审留时间。没安排资源的降本工作会变成隐藏加班。

lines.en: We'll replace lower-priority work, not add everything. Managers must publish which tasks move later.
lines.zh: 替换低优先级工作，不是全部追加。经理必须公布延后的任务。

dialogues.title: 员工问裁员、考核和公平性
dialogues.premise: 责任分工公布，进入员工对政策影响的直接追问。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出管理层明确回答什么、没有保证什么。

lines.en: So, are we facing across-the-board cuts later? Some colleagues heard savings and assumed job losses.
lines.zh: 那么，以后会一刀切吗？有同事听到节省就以为要裁员。

lines.en: Well, this plan contains no job cuts. I can't promise every future company decision.
lines.zh: 嗯，这份方案不含裁员。我不能保证公司未来每个决定。

lines.en: Okay, thanks for separating those two claims. Will missed savings targets affect individual performance reviews?
lines.zh: 好，感谢区分两个说法。没达节省目标影响个人绩效吗？

lines.en: Not through an automatic savings score itself. We evaluate sound decisions, evidence, and agreed responsibilities.
lines.zh: 不会通过自动节省分数。评价合理决策、证据和约定职责。

lines.en: Right, shared accountability includes explaining uncontrollable demand. Finance won't rank teams by raw bills.
lines.zh: 对，共同责任包含解释不可控需求。财务不会按原始账单排名。

lines.en: Just to confirm, failed safe tests count, right? Maybe my team finds no acceptable reduction.
lines.zh: 确认一下，安全试验失败也算成果，对吧？我团队可能找不到可接受缩减。

lines.en: That evidence should still guide a decision. Otherwise people might conceal the expensive failure cases.
lines.zh: 那证据仍应指导决定。否则大家可能隐瞒昂贵的失败情况。

lines.en: Agreed, we commit to reporting those outcomes. A rejected unsafe option is useful work.
lines.zh: 同意，我们承诺报告那些结果。拒绝不安全方案是有效工作。

lines.en: Individual cases can take it offline afterward. Public questions still get an anonymized policy answer.
lines.zh: 个人情况之后可以单聊。公开问题仍会得到匿名化政策回答。

lines.en: A league table? Let's park that idea. The policy rewards useful evidence, not cosmetic rankings.
lines.zh: 排行榜？先不考虑。政策重视有效证据，不是好看排名。

dialogues.title: 质疑削冗余应有出口
dialogues.premise: 员工认可考核澄清，继续追问可靠性和采购风险。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住提出担忧的渠道及采购安全边界。

lines.en: Well, can I raise a concern about redundancy? A manager could call spare capacity unnecessary.
lines.zh: 嗯，能提一下冗余担忧吗？经理可能把备用容量说成不必要。

lines.en: We protect the reliability baseline through review. Any redundancy reduction needs reliability-owner approval first.
lines.zh: 通过评审保护可靠性基线。缩冗余必须先得到可靠性负责人批准。

lines.en: And the escalation path avoids that manager? People may need an independent technical review.
lines.zh: 升级路径可以绕开那经理吗？大家可能需要独立技术评审。

lines.en: Yes, the reliability council reviews disputed changes. Document the concern before approving the purchase.
lines.zh: 可以，可靠性委员会评审争议变更。批准采购前记录担忧。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no across-the-board cuts, right? Contracts also need peak demand and exit checks.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不一刀切，对吧？合同也要核查峰值需求和退出限制。

lines.en: Exactly, a long commitment may trap us. What happens if the planned migration changes providers?
lines.zh: 对，长期承诺可能困住我们。计划迁移若换厂商怎么办？

lines.en: Our working hypothesis must include that possibility. Maybe a smaller commitment preserves enough flexibility.
lines.zh: 当前假设必须包含那可能。较小承诺可能保留足够灵活性。

lines.en: So, no contract is approved here today. Cancellation and exchange rights require written confirmation.
lines.zh: 所以，今天这里不批准任何合同。取消和交换权利需要书面确认。

lines.en: Okay, discounts aren't capacity guarantees by themselves. Peak availability needs separate engineering and procurement checks.
lines.zh: 好，折扣本身不是容量保证。峰值可用能力需要独立工程和采购检查。

lines.en: We'll keep those restrictions in every proposal. Nobody should learn the lock-in after signing.
lines.zh: 每个提案都保留这些限制。不能签后才知道被锁定。

dialogues.title: 四周后公开结果，不提前宣布成功
dialogues.premise: 风险渠道明确，管理层宣布实施与反馈时间。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住两周提交、四周反馈和异常提前升级。

lines.en: Okay, our decision checkpoint is four weeks away. Teams submit reviewed options within two weeks.
lines.zh: 好，四周后是决策检查点。团队两周内提交评审过的方案。

lines.en: We commit to sharing outcomes at that checkpoint. Financial reconciliation may take longer than testing.
lines.zh: 承诺在检查点分享结果。财务核对可能比测试更久。

lines.en: What's the ETA for the common template? Maybe teams can avoid five different reporting formats.
lines.zh: 统一模板预计何时给？可以避免团队使用五种报告格式。

lines.en: Well, include unresolved risks and rejected options. A status report isn't just a savings total.
lines.zh: 嗯，也包含未解决风险和被拒方案。状态报告不只是节省总额。

lines.en: Today's action item includes the reporting template. Priya's team will publish it tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: 今天待办包括报告模板。Priya团队明早发布。

lines.en: We'll circle back at the next all-hands. Urgent safety concerns don't wait four weeks itself.
lines.zh: 下次全员会再跟进。紧急安全担忧不用等四周。

lines.en: Right, raise a concern through the council. Budget conflicts go through finance in parallel.
lines.zh: 对，向委员会提出担忧。预算冲突同时通过财务处理。

lines.en: Will pilot work stay inside normal hours? Our team already has a full release schedule.
lines.zh: 试点会在正常工时内吗？团队发布安排已满。

lines.en: So, managers must reprioritize before adding work. The schedule should expose capacity limits honestly.
lines.zh: 所以，经理加工作前必须重排优先级。排期应真实暴露精力限制。

lines.en: Okay, I'll review trade-offs with team leads. We'll move lower-priority features rather than assume overtime.
lines.zh: 好，与团队负责人评审取舍。延后低优先功能，不默认加班。

dialogues.title: 听清获批、暂缓与反馈责任
dialogues.premise: 全员会收尾，明确决策记录与未决事项反馈方式。
dialogues.listeningTask: 复述已批准措施、明确排除项和下次反馈时间。

lines.en: We'll publish the trade-offs with today's decisions. Just to recap, verified waste comes first.
lines.zh: 与今天决策一起公开取舍。小结一下，先处理核实的浪费。

lines.en: Right, sizing pilots need their safety gates. Long contracts and blanket reductions aren't approved.
lines.zh: 对，规格试点需要安全门槛。长期合同和全面削减未获批。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for unanswered questions? Several colleagues asked about shared cost allocation.
lines.zh: 未回答问题谁接？几位同事问了共享成本归属。

lines.en: Well, keep questions in the published record. Silence shouldn't look like agreement or resolution.
lines.zh: 嗯，把问题保留在公开记录中。沉默不应像同意或解决。

lines.en: Shared accountability includes answering those questions itself. Product and finance will review allocations together.
lines.zh: 共同责任包含回答问题本身。产品和财务共同评审归属。

lines.en: I'll close the loop by next Wednesday. Maybe some answers need a second specialist review.
lines.zh: 我下周三前闭环。部分回答可能需要第二位专家评审。

lines.en: So, publish the owner and next date. We can acknowledge uncertainty without inventing an answer.
lines.zh: 所以，公布负责人和下个日期。可以承认不确定，而不编答案。

lines.en: The decision checkpoint remains four weeks away. No layoffs are included in this approved plan.
lines.zh: 决策检查点仍是四周后。本次批准方案不含裁员。

lines.en: And backups and recovery capacity remain protected. That's the part employees need to hear clearly.
lines.zh: 备份和恢复容量继续受保护。员工需要明确听到这一点。

lines.en: Okay, we'll share the record today. Teams get priorities and time, not just another target.
lines.zh: 好，今天分享记录。团队得到优先级和时间，不只是另一个指标。
